slides.title: Future Arrangements
slides.content:
1. The Calendar Rule

We use Present Continuous (Be + Verb-ing) to talk about fixed plans in the future, especially if they are in your calendar.

  • "I am meeting the client tomorrow at 10 AM."
  • "She is flying to Paris next Friday."

*Note: You MUST include a time reference (tomorrow, next week) so people know it is not happening "right now".

2. Rescheduling Vocabulary

Can't make it: I cannot attend.
Postpone: Move to a later time.
Move up: Move to an earlier time.
Something came up: I have an unexpected problem.
slides.speech_text: Did you know we use Present Continuous for the future? If it's in your diary, say 'I am meeting him tomorrow', not 'I will meet him'. Also, if you have a conflict, you can say 'Something came up, I can't make it'.

slides.title: Changing the Meeting
slides.content: Listen to two colleagues trying to find a time to meet.
slides.audio_script:
Mark: Hi Lisa. Can we meet on Tuesday at 2 PM to discuss the budget?
        Lisa: I'm sorry, I can't make it. I am having lunch with the new director at that time.
        Mark: Oh, I see. What about Wednesday morning?
        Lisa: Wednesday is tricky. I am presenting the quarterly report until 11 AM.
        Mark: Okay, let's aim for Thursday then.
        Lisa: Thursday works perfectly. I am not doing anything urgent then.

quiz.question: Why can't Lisa meet on Tuesday?
options: She is having lunch with the director

quiz.question: What tense does she use: 'I am presenting...'?

slides.title: Select the correct form
slides.instruction: Identify if the sentence refers to NOW or the FUTURE.

questions.text: 'I am working on the report right now.'
questions.explanation: 'Right now' indica que está ocurriendo en este momento.

questions.text: 'I am seeing the dentist tomorrow morning.'
questions.explanation: 'Tomorrow morning' convierte el presente continuo en un plan futuro fijo.

questions.text: Choose the best excuse for a conflict:
questions.explanation: 'I can't make it' es la frase estándar profesional para cancelar.

slides.title: Roleplay: Rescheduling
slides.system_prompt:
You are a colleague trying to schedule a meeting with the user.
        The user has a busy schedule.
        
        Steps:
        1. Ask: "Can we meet tomorrow at 9 AM?"
        2. Wait for the user to reject it using Present Continuous (e.g., "I am visiting a client").
        3. Suggest another time (e.g., Friday).
        4. Confirm the new slot.
        
        Correction Focus: If the user says "I will visit a client", suggest "I am visiting a client" as it sounds more like a fixed plan.
slides.initial_message: Hey! We need to finalize the project. Are you free to meet tomorrow at 9:00 AM?
slides.user_goal: Decline the meeting because you have another plan (use 'I am doing...') and suggest a new time.
